issue: जनि करहि निदाना: निदान may mean 'end/limit', 'cause' or 'finally'; the half-line is read in different ways.
our reading: Do not drive my suffering to its last extreme (मेरी पीड़ाको चरम सीमातक मत पहुँचाओ), i.e. do not prolong it to the utmost; give fire instead.
alternatives: Do not delay / do not hold back (just give the fire).
Do not become the cause of further pain.
Give fire at last (निदान = finally), do not refuse.

issue: गएँ दिन चारी: literally 'after four days'; often taken idiomatically as 'in a few days'.
